card.name: Commas in lists of foods
card.fires_on: The comma (or occasional 'and') right after a food item inside a list of foods, such as fish, vegetables, fruits or nuts, in diet and nutrition advice.

modes.label: Comma between foods
modes.description: A comma after one food in a running list of healthy or pesticide-laden foods.
modes.example: You can increase the Omega-3’s in your diet by eating it in Salmon<<,>> scallops, cauliflower, broccoli, spinach

modes.label: 'and' after a food
modes.description: The word 'and' following a food item that begins a short list.
modes.example: diets high in produce—including broccoli<< and>> other veggies—may lower a woman's

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated foreign-language and odd fragments, so the pole mainly marks list position.
card.plain: It fires on the comma that separates one food from the next in a list of foods.
